cta: Who should have caught that phone call? Tell us in the comments
title: One Phone Call Doubled the Load on This Walkway
description:
Two steel walkways hung above the Hyatt Regency lobby in Kansas City. Why did they fall?
One change to a rod detail, agreed during construction, doubled the load on the connections that held them up. This is the story, told from the federal investigation report.

Sources: National Bureau of Standards walkway investigation (NIST), ASCE Civil Engineering magazine.
Based on official investigation reports and published sources. 3D scenes are reconstructions, not actual footage.
